WITH event_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_attendance
    FROM event_counts
)
SELECT ec.link_to_event AS event_id,
       ec.attendance_count,
       CAST(ec.attendance_count AS REAL) / tc.total_attendance AS share
FROM event_counts AS ec
CROSS JOIN total_count AS tc
WHERE tc.total_attendance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
